verses.text: Jesus talk these things, and e lift up im eyes to heaven, talk say, “Papa God, di hour don reach. Give your Pikin glory, so that your Pikin go give you glory too;
just as you give am authority over all flesh, e go give life wey no dey end to all di people wey you don give am.
Na this be life wey no dey end, say dem go know you, di only true God, and di one wey you send, Jesus Christ.
I give you glory for di earth. I don finish di work wey you give me to do.
Now, Papa God, give me glory with your own self, with di glory wey I get with you before di world dey.
I don reveal your name to di people wey you give me from di world. Dem be your own, and you don give dem to me. Dem don keep your word.
Now dem don know say all things wey you give me come from you,
because di words wey you give me, I don give dem, and dem receive dem, and dem know for sure say I come from you, and dem don believe say you send me.
I dey pray for dem. I no dey pray for di world, but for di people wey you give me, because dem be your own.
All things wey be mine na your own, and your own na mine, and dem don give me glory inside dem.
I no dey for di world again, and these ones dey for di world, and I dey come to you. Holy Papa God, keep dem through your name wey you give me, so that dem go be one, just as we be one.
While I dey with dem for di world, I keep dem for your name. Di ones wey you give me I don keep. None of dem lost, except di son of destruction, so that di Scripture go fulfill.
But now I dey come to you, and I dey talk these things for di world, so that dem go get my joy full inside dem.
I don give dem your word. Di world hate dem, because dem no be of di world, just as I no be of di world.
I no dey pray say make you take dem from di world, but say make you keep dem from di evil one.
Dem no be of di world just as I no be of di world.
Make dem holy by your truth. Your word na truth.
As you send me enter di world, na so I send dem enter di world.
For dem sake I make myself holy, so that dem too go dey holy by truth.
I no dey pray for these ones only, but for di people wey go believe me through dem word too,
so that dem all go be one; just as you, Papa God, dey inside me, and I inside you, so that dem go be one inside us too; so that di world go believe say you send me.
Di glory wey you give me, I don give dem; so that dem go be one, just as we be one;
I inside dem, and you inside me, so that dem go dey perfect as one; so that di world go know say you send me, and love dem, just as you love me.
Papa God, I want say di people wey you give me dey with me wia I dey, so that dem go see my glory, wey you give me, because you love me before di foundation of di world.
Righteous Papa God, di world no know you, but I know you; and these ones know say you send me.
I don make your name known to dem, and I go make am known; so that di love wey you love me with go dey inside dem, and I inside dem.”
When Jesus don talk these words, e go out with im disciples cross Kidron brook, wia garden dey, wey e and im disciples enter.
Now Judas, wey betray am, know di place too, because Jesus dey meet there with im disciples plenty times.
So Judas, as e don take di group of soldiers, and officers from di chief priests and di Pharisees, come there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
So Jesus, as e know all di things wey dey come on am, go forward, talk to dem say, “Who una dey look for?”
Dem answer am, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus talk to dem say, “Na me.” Judas too, wey betray am, dey stand with dem.
So when e talk to dem, “Na me,” dem go backward, fall for ground.
Again e ask dem, “Who una dey look for?” Dem talk say, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
Jesus answer, “I don tell una say na me. So if na me una dey look for, make these ones go dem way,”
so that di word go fulfill wey e talk, “Of di ones wey you give me, I no lose any.”
Simon Peter get sword, draw am, strike di high priest servant, cut im right ear. Di servant name na Malchus.
So Jesus talk to Peter say, “Put your sword inside im sheath. Di cup wey Papa God give me, I no go drink am?”
So di soldiers, di commanding officer, and di officers of di Jews, catch Jesus and tie am,
and lead am to Annas first, because e be Caiaphas father-in-law, wey be high priest that year.
Now na Caiaphas advise di Jews say e better say one man perish for di people.
Simon Peter follow Jesus, and another disciple too. Now that disciple dem know am to di high priest, and e enter with Jesus inside di high priest courtyard;
but Peter stand for di door outside. So di other disciple, wey dem know to di high priest, go out talk to di woman wey dey keep di door, bring Peter enter.
Den di maid wey dey keep di door talk to Peter say, “You be one of this man disciples too?” E talk say, “I no be.”
Now di servants and di officers dey stand there, as dem don make fire of coals, because cold dey. Dem dey warm demself. Peter dey with dem, dey stand dey warm imself.
So di high priest ask Jesus about im disciples, and about im teaching.
Jesus answer am, “I talk openly to di world. I always teach for synagogues, and for di temple, wia di Jews always dey meet. I no talk anything for secret.
Why you dey ask me? Ask di people wey don hear me wetin I talk to dem. Look, these ones know di things wey I talk.”
When e don talk this, one of di officers wey stand there slap Jesus with im hand, dey talk say, “You dey answer di high priest like that?”
Jesus answer am, “If I talk evil, testify about di evil; but if I talk well, why you dey beat me?”
So Annas send am tie go Caiaphas, di high priest.
Now Simon Peter dey stand dey warm imself. So dem talk to am say, “You no be one of im disciples too?” E deny am, talk say, “I no be.”
One of di servants of di high priest, wey be relative of di one wey Peter cut im ear, talk say, “I no see you for di garden with am?”
So Peter deny again, and at once cock crow.
So dem lead Jesus from Caiaphas go di Praetorium. E early, and dem imself no enter di Praetorium, so that dem no go dey defiled, but dem go chop di Passover.
So Pilate go out to dem, talk say, “Wetin accusation una dey bring against this man?”
Dem answer am, “If this man no be evildoer, we no go don deliver am to you.”
So Pilate talk to dem say, “Take am yourselves, judge am according to una law.” Di Jews talk to am say, “Law no allow us to kill anybody,”
so that di word of Jesus go fulfill, wey e talk, to show wetin kind death e go die.
So Pilate enter di Praetorium again, call Jesus, talk to am say, “You na di King of di Jews?”
Jesus answer am, “You dey talk this by yourself, or others tell you about me?”
Pilate answer, “You think say I be Jew? Your own nation and di chief priests deliver you to me. Wetin you do?”
Jesus answer, “My Kingdom no be of this world. If my Kingdom na of this world, den my servants go fight, so that dem no go deliver me to di Jews. But now my Kingdom no come from here.”

So Pilate talk to am say, “Den you na king?” Jesus answer, “You talk say I be king. Na for this dem born me, and na for this I come enter di world, so that I go testify to di truth. Everybody wey belong to di truth dey listen to my voice.”
Pilate talk to am say, “Wetin be truth?” When e don talk this, e go out again to di Jews, talk to dem say, “I no find any reason to accuse am.
But una get custom, say I go release somebody to una for di Passover. So una want make I release di King of di Jews to una?”
Den dem all shout again, dey talk say, “No be this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas na robber.
So Pilate take Jesus and whip am.
Di soldiers twist thorns make crown, put am on im head, and dress am with purple cloth.
Dem dey talk, “Hail, King of di Jews!” and dem dey slap am.
Pilate go out again, talk to dem say, “Look, I dey bring am out to una, so that una go know say I no find any reason to accuse am.”
So Jesus come out, wey wear di crown of thorns and di purple cloth. Pilate talk to dem say, “Look, di man!”

So when di chief priests and di officers see am, dem shout, dey talk say, “Crucify am! Crucify am!” Pilate talk to dem say, “Take am yourselves, crucify am, because I no find any reason to accuse am.”
Di Jews answer am, “We get law, and by our law e must die, because e make imself God Pikin.”
So when Pilate hear this word, e fear more.
E enter di Praetorium again, talk to Jesus say, “Wia you come from?” But Jesus no give am any answer.
So Pilate talk to am say, “You no dey talk to me? You no know say I get power to release you, and get power to crucify you?”
Jesus answer, “You no go get any power against me, unless dem give you from above. So di one wey deliver me to you get greater sin.”
From this, Pilate dey try release am, but di Jews shout, dey talk say, “If you release this man, you no be Caesar friend! Everybody wey make imself king dey talk against Caesar!”
So when Pilate hear these words, e bring Jesus out, sit down for di judgment seat for one place wey dem call “Di Pavement,” but for Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”
Now na di Preparation Day of di Passover, about di sixth hour. E talk to di Jews say, “Look, your King!”
Dem shout, “Take am away! Take am away! Crucify am!” Pilate talk to dem say, “I go crucify your King?” Di chief priests answer, “We no get king except Caesar!”
So e deliver am to dem make dem crucify am. So dem take Jesus lead am go.
E go out, dey carry im cross, go di place wey dem call “Di Place of Skull,” wey dem call for Hebrew, “Golgotha,”
wia dem crucify am, and with am two others, one for each side, and Jesus for middle.
Pilate write title too, put am on di cross. Dem write, “Jesus of Nazareth, di King of di Jews.”
So plenty of di Jews read this title, because di place wia dem crucify Jesus near di town; and dem write am for Hebrew, for Latin, and for Greek.
So di chief priests of di Jews talk to Pilate say, “No write, ‘Di King of di Jews,’ but, ‘E talk say, I be King of di Jews.’”
Pilate answer, “Wetin I don write, I don write.”
Den di soldiers, when dem don crucify Jesus, take im clothes make four parts, one part for each soldier, and di coat too. Now di coat no get seam, dem weave am from top throughout.

Den dem talk to each other say, “Make we no tear am, but make we throw lots for am, to decide who own e go be,” so that di Scripture go fulfill, wey talk say, “Dem share my clothes among dem. For my cloak dem throw lots.” So di soldiers do these things.
But for di cross of Jesus im mama dey stand, and im mama sister, Mary wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
So when Jesus see im mama, and di disciple wey e love dey stand near, e talk to im mama say, “Woman, look, your son!”
Den e talk to di disciple say, “Look, your mama!” From that hour, di disciple take am go im own house.
After this, Jesus, as e know say all things don finish, so that di Scripture go fulfill, talk say, “I thirsty.”
Now one vessel full of vinegar dey there, so dem put sponge full of di vinegar for hyssop, hold am to im mouth.
So when Jesus receive di vinegar, e talk say, “E don finish.” Den e bow im head, give up im spirit.
So di Jews, because na Preparation Day, so that di bodies no go remain on di cross for Sabbath—because that Sabbath na special one—ask Pilate say make dem break dem legs, and make dem take dem away.
So di soldiers come, break di legs of di first, and of di other one wey dem crucify with am;
but when dem reach Jesus, and see say e don die already, dem no break im legs.
But one of di soldiers pierce im side with spear, and at once blood and water come out.
Di one wey see don testify, and im testimony na true. E know say e dey talk di truth, so that una go believe.
Because these things happen, so that di Scripture go fulfill, “Dem no go break one bone of am.”
Again another Scripture talk say, “Dem go look di one wey dem pierce.”
After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, wey be disciple of Jesus, but for secret because of fear of di Jews, ask Pilate make e take Jesus body. Pilate give am permission. So e come take im body.
Nicodemus, wey first come to Jesus for night, come too, dey bring mixture of myrrh and aloes, about 100 Roman pounds.
So dem take Jesus body, tie am for linen cloths with di spices, as di custom of di Jews dey bury.
Now for di place wia dem crucify am, garden dey. For di garden, new tomb dey wey nobody don ever lie.
So because of di Jews Preparation Day—because di tomb near—dem put Jesus there.
Now for di first day of di week, Mary Magdalene go early, while e still dark, to di tomb, see say dem don take away di stone from di tomb.
So e run come to Simon Peter, and to di other disciple wey Jesus love, talk to dem say, “Dem don take Lord out of di tomb, and we no know wia dem put am!”
So Peter and di other disciple go out, and dem go towards di tomb.
Dem both run together. Di other disciple run pass Peter, reach di tomb first.
E bend look inside, see di linen cloths dey lie, but e no enter.
Den Simon Peter come, dey follow am, and enter di tomb. E see di linen cloths dey lie,
and di cloth wey dey im head, no dey lie with di linen cloths, but dem roll am up for one place by imself.
So di other disciple wey first reach di tomb enter too, and e see and believe.
Because dem never know di Scripture say e must rise from di dead.
So di disciples go back go dem own houses.
But Mary dey stand outside for di tomb dey cry. So, as e dey cry, e bend look inside di tomb,
and e see two angels wey wear white dey sit, one for di head, and one for di feet, wia Jesus body lie.
Dem talk to am say, “Woman, why you dey cry?” E talk to dem say, “Because dem don take my Lord away, and I no know wia dem put am.”
When e don talk this, e turn round see Jesus dey stand, and e no know say na Jesus.
Jesus talk to am say, “Woman, why you dey cry? Who you dey look for?” E think say na di gardener, talk to am say, “Oga, if you don carry am go, tell me wia you put am, and I go take am away.”
Jesus talk to am say, “Mary.” E turn talk to am say, “Rabboni!” wey mean, “Teacher!”
Jesus talk to am say, “No touch me, because I never go up to my Papa God; but go to my brothers, tell dem, ‘I dey go up to my Papa God and una Papa God, to my God and una God.’”
Mary Magdalene come tell di disciples say e don see Lord, and say e talk these things to am.

So when evening reach, for that day, di first day of di week, and when dem don lock di doors wia di disciples dey, because of fear of di Jews, Jesus come stand for middle, talk to dem say, “Peace dey with una.”
When e don talk this, e show dem im hands and im side. So di disciples glad when dem see Lord.
So Jesus talk to dem again, “Peace dey with una. As Papa God don send me, na so I dey send una.”
When e don talk this, e breathe on dem, talk to dem say, “Receive Holy Spirit!
If una forgive anybody sins, dem don forgive dem. If una hold anybody sins, dem don hold dem.”
But Thomas, one of di 12, wey dem call Didymus, no dey with dem when Jesus come.

So di other disciples talk to am say, “We don see Lord!” But e talk to dem say, “Unless I see di mark of di nails for im hands, and put my finger inside di mark of di nails, and put my hand inside im side, I no go believe.”
After eight days, again im disciples dey inside, and Thomas dey with dem. Jesus come, as dem don lock di doors, and stand for middle, talk say, “Peace dey with una.”
Den e talk to Thomas say, “Put your finger here, see my hands. Put your hand here, put am inside my side. No be unbeliever, but believer.”
Thomas answer am, “My Lord and my God!”
Jesus talk to am say, “Because you don see me, you don believe. Blessed be di people wey no see, and don believe.”
So Jesus do plenty other signs before im disciples, wey dem no write for this book;
but dem write these ones, so that una go believe say Jesus na di Christ, God Pikin; and say as una believe una go get life for im name.
After these things, Jesus show imself again to di disciples for di Sea of Tiberias. E show imself this way.
Simon Peter, Thomas wey dem call Didymus, Nathanael of Cana for Galilee, Zebedee sons, and two others of im disciples dey together.
Simon Peter talk to dem say, “I dey go fish.” Dem tell am say, “We dey come with you too.” Dem go out at once, enter di boat. That night, dem no catch anything.
But when day don break, Jesus stand for di beach; yet di disciples no know say na Jesus.
So Jesus talk to dem say, “My pikin dem, una get anything to chop?” Dem answer am, “No.”
E talk to dem say, “Throw di net for di right side of di boat, and una go find some.” So dem throw am, and now dem no fit pull am in because of di plenty fish.
So that disciple wey Jesus love talk to Peter say, “Na Lord!” So when Simon Peter hear say na Lord, e wrap im coat round imself—because e naked—and throw imself inside di sea.
But di other disciples come inside di small boat—because dem no far from di land, but about 200 cubits away—dey drag di net full of fish.
So when dem come out for land, dem see fire of coals dey there, and fish dey on am, and bread.
Jesus talk to dem say, “Bring some of di fish wey una just catch.”
Simon Peter go up, draw di net come land, full of 153 big fish. Even though plenty dey so, di net no tear.
Jesus talk to dem say, “Come chop breakfast.” None of di disciples dare ask am, “Who you be?” as dem know say na Lord.
Jesus come take di bread, give dem, and di fish too.
Na di third time now say Jesus show imself to im disciples, after e don rise from di dead.

So when dem don chop dem breakfast, Jesus talk to Simon Peter say, “Simon, Jonah son, you love me pass these?” E talk to am say, “Yes, Lord; you know say I get affection for you.” E talk to am say, “Feed my lambs.”
E talk to am again di second time, “Simon, Jonah son, you love me?” E talk to am say, “Yes, Lord; you know say I get affection for you.” E talk to am say, “Take care of my sheep.”

E talk to am di third time, “Simon, Jonah son, you get affection for me?” Peter sad because e ask am di third time, “You get affection for me?” E talk to am say, “Lord, you know everything. You know say I get affection for you.” Jesus talk to am say, “Feed my sheep.

Na true I dey tell you, when you dey young, you dey dress yourself, and dey waka wia you want. But when you don old, you go stretch out your hands, and another person go dress you, and carry you go wia you no want go.”
Now e talk this, to show wetin kind death e go die to give God glory. When e don talk this, e talk to am say, “Follow me.”
Peter turn round, see di disciple wey Jesus love dey follow, wey lean for im chest for di supper too, ask, “Lord, who be di one wey go betray you?”
As Peter see am, e talk to Jesus say, “Lord, wetin about this man?”
Jesus talk to am say, “If I want say e stay until I come, wetin concern you? You follow me.”
So this word spread among di brothers, say that disciple no go die. Yet Jesus no talk to am say e no go die, but, “If I want say e stay until I come, wetin concern you?”
Na this disciple dey testify about these things, and write these things. We know say im witness na true.
Plenty other things dey wey Jesus do, wey if dem write dem all, I think say even di world imself no go get room for di books wey dem go write.
